How to play

Chance is a tool. These are the moves.

01

Pick a word

DADA, STIJL, CARSON, COLLAGE, CHANCE, MERZ, TACTICS, IMPROBABLE, PRINT or PLAY. Type styles all share one built-in blocky-to-blobby alphabet.

02

Roll the dice

Randomize deals a new composition: seeds drive every hash. Reshuffle, Pulls and Re-colours re-deal on a beat.

03

Feed it an image

Drop a photo or clip on Tzara's Bag, Photomontage or Neo-Plastic and watch it get cut, pasted and primary-coloured.

04

Stack and overprint

Layer styles with Multiply: Photocopy Type over Rough Sea, Neo-Plastic rules over Dot Quilt. Keyframe anything.

What's in the box

  • 12 styles in 5 groups: Dada, Collage, De Stijl, Deconstruction, Bauhaus & Ornament
  • 145 parameters with grouped sections, a colour picker, an XY pad and conditional controls
  • 3 MEDIA styles that treat your own image or video
  • Procedural fallback source, so nothing is ever blank

Built for Motif

  • Seamless loops: time only enters through integer cycles per loop
  • Photosensitive limiter honoured on every re-deal and re-colour
  • Works with layers, blend modes, masks, keyframes, Mutate, Evolve and every export
  • Install: drop improbable-tactics-0.1.0.motifkit on Motif 3.2
